title: Caption Clarity
user: People with high-frequency hearing loss who need captions styled around likely-to-be-misheard dialogue rather than one undifferentiated text stream.
smallest_useful_product: A local WebVTT/SRT player and standards-compliant video overlay with profiles for emphasis, line length, pause-on-keyword, and user-defined confusing terms.
success_measure: In a 30-minute comprehension test with supplied clips, profile users rewind at least 25% less than with ordinary captions.
constraints: No media hosting or DRM bypass; preserve copyright by accepting only local/user-authorized media; make all profiles adjustable rather than implying medical recommendations.
